# Scientists Discover High-Altitude Unicorn Colony in Remote Andean Valley

**LA PAZ, Bolivia** — In what is being called one of the most extraordinary zoological discoveries of the century, a team of researchers from the Universidad Nacional de La Paz has reportedly identified a small herd of equine creatures bearing single, spiraling horn-like protrusions in a previously unmapped valley deep in the Andes Mountains.

---
